modalities.evidence: This dataset contains raw 7T fMRI data from 20 subjects

output.population: 20 subjects who completed a visual task; human, ages 19–36
output.summary: Raw 7T fMRI from 20 subjects viewing a radial checkerboard flickering at 12 Hz, with stimulus durations from 0.167 to 16 seconds, supporting work on sensory-driven cerebrospinal fluid flow.
